correctness.rationale: Given P_{p,q}=A_p⊕B_q with p,q≥2, product order on F₂(P) of distinct ordered pairs produces AA,AB,BA,BB types. For mixed (a_i,b_j), strict lower = {(a_i,a_k):k≠i} (p−1 incomparable points), strict upper = {(b_l,b_j):l≠j} (q−1 incomparable points); BA symmetric. Hence beat status exactly p=2 (down) or q=2 (up). Same-level AA has incomparable AB and BA above, BB dual below, so neither beat. If both ≥3, all (p+q)(p+q−1) are core points. If p=2, successive deletion of mixed down beat points preserves their unique AA lower and leaves 2 AA below q(q−1) BB, exactly P_{2,q(q−1)} and beat-free; dual q=2. Verified independently using freshly coded product poset enumeration for all 49 parameter pairs 2≤p,q≤8 and inspected actual packaged artifacts/verify.py. Finite enumeration corroborates; the displayed antichain formulas prove every integer p,q≥2.
